name: Honda NC750X
engine: 745 cc liquid-cooled parallel twin, fuel injected, manual or DCT
intro: Honda's practical crossover, with storage where the tank usually is. Some have the DCT gearbox.

A-002.title: Check for open recalls
A-002.instructions: Run your VIN at nhtsa.gov/recalls. 2021 NC750X DCT bikes were in recall 21V901 for fuel injection programming, and some 2024 bikes are in recall 25V435 for the front tire.
A-002.reason: Both can cause a crash. Repairs are free.

recalls.what: Fuel injection programming can starve the engine and stall it.
Front tire inner structure may loosen and unravel.
